params.code: local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); local p = Scene.FindEntityByName('Paddle').Translation; local b = Scene.FindEntityByName('Ball').Translation; assert(math.abs(p.x - 3.5) < 1e-4, 'paddle ' .. p.x); assert(math.abs(b.x - p.x) < 1e-4 and b.y > p.y, 'ball does not ride the paddle'); return p.x
local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); assert(math.abs(g.PaddleX) < 1e-4, 'paddle ' .. g.PaddleX); return g.PaddleX
local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); assert(math.abs(g.PaddleX) < 1e-4, 'paddle ' .. g.PaddleX); return g.PaddleX
local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); assert(math.abs(g.PaddleX - g.PaddleLimit) < 1e-4, 'paddle ' .. g.PaddleX); return g.PaddleX
local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); assert(math.abs(g.PaddleX - g.PaddleLimit) < 1e-4, 'the stick at rest moved the paddle: ' .. g.PaddleX); return g.PaddleX
local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); assert(math.abs(g.PaddleX - (g.PaddleLimit - 3.5)) < 1e-4, 'paddle ' .. g.PaddleX); return g.PaddleX
local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); MouseStartX = g.PaddleX; return g.PaddleX
local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); assert(math.abs(g.PaddleX - (MouseStartX - 2.4)) < 1e-4, 'paddle ' .. g.PaddleX .. ' from ' .. MouseStartX); return g.PaddleX
Input.SetBindings('MoveX', { { Key = 'L' }, { Key = 'J', Scale = -1 } }); return #Input.GetBindings('MoveX')
local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); RebindStartX = g.PaddleX; return g.PaddleX
local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); assert(g.PaddleX == RebindStartX, 'Right still moves the paddle'); return g.PaddleX
local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); assert(g.PaddleX > RebindStartX, 'L does not move the paddle'); Input.ResetBindings('MoveX'); return #Input.GetBindings('MoveX')

local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); local v = Scene.FindEntityByName('Ball'):GetLinearVelocity(); assert(g.State == 'Play', g.State); assert(v.y > 0 and math.abs(v:Length() - g.BallSpeed) < 1e-3, 'velocity ' .. tostring(v)); return v:Length()
local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); g.Autopilot = true; return true

local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); local v = Scene.FindEntityByName('Ball'):GetLinearVelocity(); assert(g.BricksLeft < 40 and #Scene.FindEntitiesByName('Brick') == g.BricksLeft, 'bricks ' .. g.BricksLeft); assert(g.Score > 0 and g.LivesLeft == 3, 'score ' .. g.Score .. ' lives ' .. g.LivesLeft); assert(g.PaddleHits > 0, 'no paddle hits'); assert(math.abs(v:Length() - g.BallSpeed) < 1e-3 and math.abs(v.y) >= g.MinVertical * g.BallSpeed - 1e-3, 'velocity ' .. tostring(v)); assert(Scene.FindEntityByName('Ball').Translation.z == 0, 'the ball left the plane'); return g.Score

local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); assert(Scene.FindEntityByName('ScoreText'):GetComponent('UIText').Text == 'SCORE ' .. g.Score, 'HUD'); local n = Scene.FindEntityByName('BrickBurst'):GetParticleCount(); return g.Score .. ' ' .. n

local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); g.Autopilot = false; g.PaddleX = -g.PaddleLimit; local b = Scene.FindEntityByName('Ball'); b.Translation = Vec3(6, 0.4, 0); b:SetLinearVelocity(Vec3(0, -9, 0)); return true
local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); assert(g.LivesLeft == 2 and g.State == 'Serve', g.State .. ' lives ' .. g.LivesLeft); return g.LivesLeft
local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); g.LivesLeft = 1; return true

local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); assert(g.State == 'Play', g.State); g.PaddleX = -g.PaddleLimit; local b = Scene.FindEntityByName('Ball'); b.Translation = Vec3(6, 0.4, 0); b:SetLinearVelocity(Vec3(0, -9, 0)); return true

local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); assert(g.State == 'Serve' and g.Score == 0 and g.LivesLeft == 3, g.State .. ' ' .. g.Score .. ' ' .. g.LivesLeft); assert(#Scene.FindEntitiesByName('Brick') == 40 and g.BricksLeft == 40, 'bricks ' .. #Scene.FindEntitiesByName('Brick')); return g.State

local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); local bricks = Scene.FindEntitiesByName('Brick'); for i = 2, #bricks do bricks[i]:Destroy() end; g.BricksLeft = 1; LastBrick = bricks[1].Translation; return #bricks

local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); local b = Scene.FindEntityByName('Ball'); b.Translation = Vec3(LastBrick.x, LastBrick.y - 1.5, 0); b:SetLinearVelocity(Vec3(0, 9, 0)); return true

local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); assert(g.State == 'Won' and g.BricksLeft == 0, g.State .. ' ' .. g.BricksLeft); assert(g.Score > 0 and g.Score % 10 == 0, 'score ' .. g.Score); return g.Score
local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); assert(g.State == 'Serve' and g.BricksLeft == 40, g.State); return g.State
local g = Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript(); assert(g.State == 'Serve', 'the restart key also served: ' .. g.State); return g.State
